newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean stocks end mixed as market hits resistance.
newsitem.headline: Chilean stocks end mixed as market hits resistance.

text.p: Chilean shares closed mixed in quiet trade with investors confident that the market has found its footing after a bout of profit-taking and could test higher ground next week, said traders.
"The atmosphere is more positive. It's a good sign that the market has reached a point of resistance," said one trader.
The selective IPSA index ended up 0.2 percent at 102.25 points. The general IGPA index shed 0.12 percent at 5,554.2 points amid volume of 9.4 billion pesos.
